title: File the company income tax return
summary: Prepare, review, authorize and file the company income tax return with the applicable tax authority, and arrange payment of any tax due.

parts.title: Export financial data from the accounting system
parts.guidance: Export the complete financial records and supporting schedules for the tax period. Reconcile them with the books and share them privately with the appointed tax adviser.

execution.rationale: QuickBooks Reports APIs export the requested statements and transaction reports for period reconciliation.

parts.title: Send financials to the tax adviser
parts.guidance: Send the reconciled financials and supporting records privately to the authorized tax adviser. Track missing information and confirm the filing responsibilities and deadlines.

execution.rationale: For the retained Gmail method, send the approved preparer package and attachments through the configured account.

parts.title: The tax adviser prepares the company return
parts.guidance: The appointed adviser prepares the company income tax return under the local rules using the reconciled records. Resolve missing information and review questions before the draft moves to approval.

options.title: Default — CPA prepares return (2-3 weeks)
options.summary: Work with the engaged CPA on the agreed returns, elections and schedules for this entity and year. Supply reconciled records and answer questions, then review proposed adjustments and remaining issues. Confirm who handles signature authorization, transmission and payment under the engagement so preparation can move into filing without an unassigned responsibility.

execution.rationale: The engaged CPA prepares the return with digital books and records, answers questions and coordinates review with the company; filing authority remains separate.

options.title: Startup tax platform
options.summary: Check that the tax service supports the entity, ownership structure, states, elections and unusual transactions involved. Compare preparation and review responsibility, question handling, price and exclusions. Provide records through its secure process, then reconcile the draft to the books and obtain the required signature authorization. Check imported figures and resulting tax treatment before authorizing filing.
options.when: No CPA relationship - a startup tax platform prepares and files the return

execution.rationale: The company and selected tax professional exchange records through the service's secure digital process and personally review return-specific signing and filing authorization requirements.

parts.title: Review draft return
parts.guidance: Compare the draft with final books, carryforwards, ownership records and significant transactions. Review tax adjustments, elections, related-party reporting and estimated payments with the preparer. Resolve unfamiliar figures and verify the entity and period before approving the exact return version through the company’s filing process. Treat any payment instruction as a distinct decision.

execution.rationale: The company and tax adviser compare the draft return with books and transaction records through the secure digital review process.

parts.title: Sign the filing authorization required by the tax authority
parts.guidance: The authorized company representative reviews and signs the filing authorization or declarations required by the selected tax authority. Keep the authorization with the approved draft and confirm who may submit it.

execution.rationale: The authorized officer reviews the electronic return and personally completes the preparer's permitted digital authorization process; no agent signs for the officer.

geoResolutions.label: Officer signs the e-file authorization (Form 8879-CORP)
geoResolutions.guidance: Prepare the annual federal corporate tax return (Form 1120) and file with the IRS. For a return using Form 8879-CORP, the authorized corporate officer reviews the complete electronic return before signing. Verify the corporation, year, required return figures and any electronic-withdrawal consent against the reviewed draft. Resolve changes with the electronic return originator, then sign and return the authorization securely. Keep it associated with the return it authorizes.

parts.title: The tax adviser files the company return
parts.guidance: Use the selected tax authority’s filing procedure for the approved return. The authorized filer submits it and retains the filing acknowledgement and any follow-up requirements.

verify.how: The IRS e-file acceptance acknowledgment comes back through the CPA — retain it with the signed copy of the return.

execution.rationale: The authored method assigns transmission, rejection handling and the returned e-file acknowledgement to the CPA. IRS business e-file guidance documents the authorized provider’s electronic transmission and acknowledgement responsibilities. The CPA retains filing responsibility; the company supplies the approved return and required signature authorization. Separately required paper attachments or an e-file exception need a separate method check.

geoResolutions.label: CPA files return with IRS
geoResolutions.guidance: Confirm the preparer has the approved return and required signature authorization before transmission. Obtain the filing acknowledgement and distinguish acceptance from rejection. Resolve rejected submissions promptly, reviewing material corrections before retransmission. Preserve the filed return and acceptance, and check any separately required forms or attachments the preparer identified.

geoResolutions.label: File the company ITR-6 return
geoResolutions.guidance: Companies file the ITR-6 return electronically on the Income Tax e-filing portal; the tax year runs April–March rather than the calendar year.

geoResolutions.label: File the CT600 Company Tax Return with HMRC
geoResolutions.guidance: The company files a CT600 Company Tax Return with HMRC within 12 months of its accounting period end — plus statutory accounts to Companies House.

geoResolutions.label: File the corporation and trade tax returns through ELSTER
geoResolutions.guidance: Corporation tax (Körperschaftsteuer) plus trade tax (Gewerbesteuer) returns are filed electronically through ELSTER, in practice via a Steuerberater.

geoResolutions.label: File the corporate income tax return through the professional tax account
geoResolutions.guidance: Corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) is declared and paid through the company's espace professionnel on impots.gouv.fr.

geoResolutions.label: File the Modelo 22 corporate income tax return
geoResolutions.guidance: The company files the Modelo 22 (IRC) return electronically through the Portal das Finanças by the end of May for calendar-year companies, plus the IES annual declaration — in practice via a certified accountant (contabilista certificado).

geoResolutions.label: File the T2 corporation income tax return
geoResolutions.guidance: The company files a T2 corporation income tax return with the CRA within six months of its fiscal year-end (tax owing is due earlier), plus any provincial corporate returns outside the CRA-administered provinces.

parts.title: Pay any company tax due
parts.guidance: Confirm the amount, payment reference, authority and deadline with the tax adviser. Obtain authorization for payment through the authority’s supported method and retain the receipt.

verify.how: IRS Direct Pay or EFTPS issues a payment confirmation number and the payment posts to the business tax account.

execution.rationale: The authorized company representative checks the return's payment instructions and completes the balance payment through the approved digital payment service.

geoResolutions.label: Pay any tax due
geoResolutions.guidance: Reconcile the balance due with credits, estimated payments and any electronic withdrawal already authorized. Verify taxpayer, period, payment type, amount and due date with the preparer. Use the company’s payment-approval process and check settlement. Match any debit included with filing before paying again, and resolve failed or missing payments against the tax account.

parts.title: File copy in records
parts.guidance: File the submitted return, schedules, elections, signature authorization, acceptance and payment evidence together. Keep supporting workpapers and explanations of material positions, with drafts clearly separate. Apply the relevant retention and access arrangements so a new preparer can understand the filed position and any later notice or amendment can be investigated.

execution.rationale: Google Drive uploads retain the filed return and supporting records; its permission operations apply the approved restricted access to the package.

metadata.supportReason: Tax filing requires a CPA. System compiles financial data, tracks deadlines, coordinates with accountant.

geoNotes.actionLabel: Income tax for companies — Inland Revenue

geoNotes.summary: The company files its corporate income tax return (Form C-S or Form C) with IRAS by 30 November for each year of assessment via the myTax Portal — a flat 17% rate, with the start-up exemption trimming the first three YAs.

The company lodges an annual company tax return with the ATO for its income year; due dates follow the ATO lodgment program (registered tax agents get extended schedules), and most startups lodge through an agent alongside their activity statements.

The corporate tax return goes to the NTS within three months from the end of the month in which the business year ends (Corporate Tax Act Article 60), filed through Hometax; local income tax follows to the municipality.

The company files its profits tax return with the Inland Revenue Department when the return issues, by the date it states; corporate profits are taxed on a territorial basis at the two-tiered 8.25%/16.5% rates (law rule hk.profits-tax-two-tier-rates).

The yearly ritual splits in two: income tax is charged only when profit is distributed and rides the monthly TSD (law rule ee.corporate-tax-distributed-profits), while the annual report to the commercial register, due in six months, is the yearly compliance document (law rule ee.annual-report-deadline).
